notes.title: BAN: The Prologue of GUCHA GUCHA_ver.2.0
notes.content:
Thank you for playing “BAN: The Prologue of GUCHA GUCHA”.
In conjunction with the Summer Sale, we have made the following updates

----------
ver 2.0.0
- Bug fixes have been made
	- Behavior around mode switching/save data has been improved.
	- Bugs such as characters not being displayed have been corrected.
	- The behavior of the murderer in the mansion has been fixed.
- Steam achievements have been added
- Mini-games have been added
	- Mini-games can be played in Utagayama after unlocking all Steam Achievements
----------

The mini-game includes new music by Ichimatsu Suzuka.
Please try to unlock all of the achievements.

Thank you for your continued support of “BAN: The Prologue of GUCHA GUCHA”.
